_meta.method: Current source and production SHA-256 inventory, fresh real-UI fixture captures, visual review and tools/w9r2-measure.mjs. Historical W9 notes below are retained as audit history; release_2026_10_11 supersedes them.
_meta.resolution_status_meaning: SUFFICIENT = source ≥ rendered size at every width (no browser upscaling; 2x is the quality target for hero roles). REPLACEMENT_REQUIRED = source is stretched below 1x at some rendered width.

release_2026_10_11.authority: Owner explicitly instructed replacement of unverified artwork and photos and deployment.
release_2026_10_11.library: Source export 1.2.0 checked against 2026-10-11 correction ledger. No shared canonical approval states or runtime 0.7.0 data changed.
release_2026_10_11.scope: All banner artwork and eight screenshots replaced; uncertain composites removed; generated originals retained; two hash-verified ingredient photos used only inside marketing sample captures.
release_2026_10_11.review: Agent visual and technical review; not owner approval of shared food-library entries.

rules: Stage14 PRODUCTION_INTEGRATION.md: hero photography ~2x largest rendered dimension; preview images are placeholders/source references, not permission to ship blurry media; do not upscale; canonical acid banner is literal, never recreated approximately.
W9-R2: prototype inclusion does not by itself prove production rights; no upscaling as closure; no unknown-rights standalone imagery; honest BLOCKED allowed.
historical_pre_release_notes.design_corpus_note: The approved artifacts' food photography (hero, jollof set, cards, strips, note/rail art) and the app's pantry design boards (web/public/reference/pantry-ingredient-source{,-2}.png) form one owner-supplied design corpus with NO recorded per-photo source, creator, or license anywhere in the project. Pixel-correlation against all 34 library-licensed images: no match (all ≈0).
historical_pre_release_notes.licensed_fallback_available: 4DK Food Library 0.7.0 (Applications/4DK MAIN/food-library/exports/current): 34 RIGHTS_VERIFIED photographs (CC-BY-SA-4.0 x25, CC0 x3, public-domain x1, CC-BY-SA-2.0 x2, CC-BY-SA-3.0 x1, CC-BY-3.0 x1, CC-BY-4.0 x1), 752-1920px, incl. Jollof rice 1920x1440 CC-BY-SA-4.0 by Ei'eke. NOT exposed in any shipped asset (verified by code path + pixel correlation). Adoption for any marketing surface is an owner visual-parity + attribution decision.
historical_pre_release_notes.w9r3_swap_2026-10-02: Six standalone editorial photos replaced with rights-clean Wikimedia Commons photography (owner-directed web-acquisition-first policy); originals backed up at .w9r3-backup/. Hero/meals/plan-grid/note/rail remain blocked (design art, untraced composite, or quota-blocked generation).
